The '''Gotal Pirates' Base''' was a large [[Warship/Legends|warship]] owned by the [[Gotal Bandits]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was used parked near the edge of the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]] and was used as a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. It served as a command post for raids against civilian traffic in the Kashyyyk system. Its position provided a strong tactical advantage to the pirates.<ref name="SWG:TGPB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal Pirates' Base appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TGPB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Gotal Pirates' Base was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TGPB" />
